name: final-preferred-depositary
filingText: Filed Pursuant to Rule 424(b)(5) Registration No. 333-276001 PROSPECTUS SUPPLEMENT dated May 7, 2026 to prospectus dated April 30, 2026 Aspen Insurance Holdings Limited 12,000,000 Depositary Shares Each Depositary Share represents a 1/1,000th ownership interest in a share of 7.000% Fixed-Rate Reset Perpetual Non-Cumulative Preference Shares, Series D, par value $0.001 per share. The Preference Shares have a liquidation preference of $25,000 per share, equivalent to $25 per Depositary Share. Dividends will accrue at a rate of 7.000% per annum, payable quarterly in arrears. We may redeem the Preference Shares on or after June 15, 2031 at a redemption price equal to $25,000 per Preference Share, plus declared and unpaid dividends. We have applied to list the Depositary Shares on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "AHLPRD".
